subject: general
question: Which state is the pioneer of zero budget natural farming?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Zero-budget natural farming method of **chemical-free agriculture drawing from traditional Indian practices.**
 
• The method was originally promoted by agriculturist **Subhash Palekar**.
 
• It is an** alternative to the Green Revolution’s methods** which promote chemical fertilizers and pesticides.
 
• It promotes the traditional method of farming.
 
• It is based on **four pillars** which are **Jeevamrutha, Bijamrita, Acchadana (Mulching) and Whapasa**.
 
• **Karnataka** is the pioneer state for zero-budget natural farming.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **
